job.title: National Sales Manager - Orthopaedics - Sydney
job.description:
National Sales Manager – Orthopaedics

Lead a substantial Australian orthopaedic business | Senior Leadership Team | Exciting growth and enabling technology pipeline

An exciting opportunity has arisen to join a leading global orthopaedic organisation as its National Sales Manager, taking responsibility for a substantial and established business across Australia.

With an impressive portfolio, ambitious growth plans and new enabling technologies on the horizon, this is an opportunity to play a pivotal role in shaping the next phase of growth for a highly regarded medical device company.

Importantly, the business has undergone significant transformation in recent years, strengthening its leadership structure, commercial processes and operational capabilities. The successful candidate will therefore inherit a business with strong foundations, established teams and genuine momentum.

This is not a turnaround appointment. It's an opportunity for an experienced and commercially driven sales leader to build on what's already been achieved and take the business to the next level.

The Opportunity

Reporting directly to the General Manager, you will assume responsibility for the national sales organisation, leading an established team of State Managers and overseeing both direct sales teams and independent sales agents.

As a key member of the Australian Senior Leadership Team, you will work closely with the General Manager and senior colleagues across Marketing, Operations and other business functions to develop and execute the commercial strategy.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Leading and developing the national sales organisation, creating a culture of accountability, collaboration and high performance.
  • Driving commercial growth across an established orthopaedic portfolio.
  • Coaching and mentoring State Managers to strengthen leadership capability and sales effectiveness.
  • Developing strong relationships with independent agents and ensuring alignment across direct and indirect sales channels.
  • Identifying new commercial opportunities and executing strategies to maximise market share.
  • Supporting the introduction and commercialisation of new products and enabling technologies.
  • Working collaboratively with the broader leadership team to strengthen sales capability, commercial processes and business performance.

What Makes This Opportunity Different?

There are several reasons why this is an attractive time to join the organisation.

An established business with momentum

Following a period of integration and operational improvement, the business is in a significantly stronger position, supported by experienced leadership, improved commercial infrastructure and a collaborative culture.

An exciting technology pipeline

With new enabling technologies on the horizon and continued investment in innovation, there are genuine opportunities to accelerate growth and further strengthen the company's position in the Australian orthopaedic market.

A genuine senior leadership position

This is much more than a national sales management role. You will have a seat at the leadership table, contributing to broader business strategy and influencing the future direction of the organisation.

The opportunity to make your mark

While the business has strong foundations, there is considerable ambition for what comes next. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to bring fresh thinking, develop people and drive meaningful commercial outcomes.

About You

We are looking for an accomplished sales leader with a strong background in the orthopaedic medical device industry.

You may already be operating as a National Sales Manager, or perhaps you're a highly successful State or Regional Sales Manager who is ready to take the next step in your leadership career.

Ideally, you will bring:

  • Proven sales leadership experience within the orthopaedic medical device industry.
  • A strong background in Joint Replacement / Arthroplasty, although experience in Trauma or potentially Spine will also be considered.
  • Demonstrated success in delivering commercial growth and developing high-performing teams.
  • The ability to lead through other managers, providing direction, coaching and accountability.
  • Strong commercial acumen, strategic thinking and an understanding of complex sales environments.
  • The ability to build relationships and influence stakeholders across different levels of a business.
  • Experience managing agents, distributors or indirect sales channels would be advantageous.
  • The confidence and maturity to operate within a global organisation and contribute at senior leadership level.

Above all, we are looking for someone with ambition, commercial drive and a genuine passion for developing people.

Someone who can see the bigger picture, challenge conventional thinking and bring the energy required to lead an established business into its next phase of growth.

What's on Offer?

  • A significant national leadership opportunity with a leading global orthopaedic organisation.
  • An established business with a strong portfolio and ambitious growth plans.
  • An experienced and supportive General Manager and broader leadership team.
  • Exciting new products and enabling technologies in development.
  • The opportunity to influence commercial strategy and business direction.
  • A highly competitive remuneration package reflective of the seniority of the position.
  • Genuine scope to make a lasting impact on the Australian business.

Location: Sydney preferred, with Melbourne or Queensland considered for the right candidate.

Interested in Learning More?

Whether you're an established National Sales Manager considering your next challenge, or a successful State or Regional Sales Manager looking to step into a broader leadership position, we'd welcome a confidential conversation.

For further information, please contact:

Jonathan Gertler
OneMD – Specialist Medical Device Recruitment
0406 423 734
jonathan.gertler@onemd.com.au

All enquiries will be treated in the strictest confidence.

job.title: Clinical Support specialist - Orthopaedics - Townsville
job.description:
Clinical Support Specialist – Medical Devices
Townsville | Permanent Part-Time | 3 Days Per Week

Build your medical device career with a global medical technology company, supporting surgical teams with innovative products and technology.

Based in Townsville, this permanent part-time position, working three days per week, offers the opportunity to combine hands-on clinical work with ongoing learning and development.

The opportunity

Working alongside experienced Territory Managers, you will receive training and support to develop your product knowledge and provide confident, reliable assistance in theatre.

Your responsibilities will include:


  • Providing clinical and technical support during surgical procedures.

  • Helping theatre teams prepare and use instrumentation and devices.

  • Building relationships with surgeons, nurses and hospital staff.

  • Supporting product education and the introduction of new technology.

  • Coordinating with the wider team to ensure cases run smoothly.

About you

You will bring:


  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills.

  • An interest in surgical technology and a willingness to learn.

  • Attention to detail and the ability to remain calm under pressure.

  • A dependable, organised approach to supporting clinical teams.

Previous operating theatre or surgical device experience would be highly regarded. You must be based in, or willing to relocate to, Townsville.

Why consider this role?


  • Permanent part-time employment, working three days per week.

  • Training and guidance from two experienced Territory Managers.

  • Exposure to innovative surgical devices and technology.

  • The opportunity to develop your career within a global medical technology business.

For a confidential discussion, contact Jonathan at OneMD or apply with your CV.

job.title: Product Manager - Knees - East Coast
job.description:
Product Manager – Knee | Orthopaedics

Sydney preferred | East Coast considered

Ready to take your orthopaedic career in a different direction?

A leading global orthopaedic organisation is looking for a Product Manager to take ownership of a highly regarded knee reconstruction portfolio, with several exciting new product introductions on the horizon.

This isn't just a portfolio-maintenance role. With new products already entering the market and further launches planned, you'll have the opportunity to work closely with surgeons, sales teams and internal stakeholders to help shape strategy, drive adoption and successfully bring new technology to market.

And importantly, you don't necessarily need to be a Product Manager already.

If you're currently working in orthopaedic sales, particularly across knee or joint reconstruction, and have been considering a move into marketing, this could be an excellent next career step.

The opportunity

You'll take ownership across key areas of the primary and revision knee portfolio, combining strategic product management with genuine field and customer engagement.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Leading and project-managing new product introductions
  • Developing portfolio strategy and key commercial messages
  • Working directly with orthopaedic surgeons to understand customer needs and drive adoption
  • Partnering closely with the sales team to translate strategy into field execution
  • Managing portfolio, inventory and asset requirements
  • Working collaboratively with local and global stakeholders
  • Supporting commercial growth across the knee portfolio
  • Helping drive engagement around new products, technologies and clinical solutions

This is not a purely desk-based marketing position. You'll remain closely connected to surgeons, customers and the commercial team, making it particularly attractive to someone who enjoys the customer-facing side of orthopaedics.

Who we're looking for

The ideal candidate would bring both knee reconstruction and product marketing experience, but we recognise that's a relatively rare combination.

Orthopaedic knowledge is the priority.

We'd therefore be interested in speaking with:

  • Existing Product Managers within orthopaedics
  • Knee or joint reconstruction sales professionals looking to transition into marketing
  • Candidates with strong hip/joints experience
  • High-quality candidates from adjacent orthopaedic portfolios such as trauma or sports medicine

You'll need strong communication and influencing skills, commercial awareness and the ability to build credibility with both surgeons and experienced sales professionals.

Most importantly, you'll need the curiosity and learning agility to move beyond your immediate area of expertise and take genuine ownership of a portfolio.

Why consider it?

For someone coming from field sales, this is an opportunity to broaden your career without walking away from orthopaedics, surgeons or the commercial side of the industry.

You'll gain exposure to portfolio strategy, product launches, NPI project management and broader commercial decision-making while being supported by an experienced marketing team.

For an existing Product Manager, the attraction is equally strong: meaningful portfolio ownership, multiple upcoming launches and the opportunity to influence the direction and growth of an important orthopaedic portfolio.

Location: Sydney preferred, although strong candidates elsewhere on the East Coast will be considered.

If you're already in orthopaedics and have wondered what a move into product management could look like, this is a great opportunity to explore it.

Contact Jonathan Gertler at OneMD for a confidential discussion. 0406 423 734

job.title: Service Technician - Rehabilitation Equipment and Assistive Technology (QLD)
job.description:
Are you technically-minded, good with your hands and love to fix things?

  • A diverse role that sees you on the road, out in the Community
  • Make a meaningful impact by assisting people live comfortable, independent lives
  • Great salary package, company vehicle and perks

The Company

Join a leading Australian healthcare equipment provider delivering mobility, daily living and facility support solutions. Trusted across hospitals, aged care and home settings, this company is committed to quality, safety and empowering healthcare providers to deliver exceptional care.
This is a field-based Monday to Friday role, combining field work from the Gold Coast to North of Brisbane with occasional work from the local workshop based in Underwood.

The Role
Working with a team of Service Technicians, Parts Specialists and Service Coordinators, you’ll be responsible for ensuring Customers are able to continue to live comfortably and / or independently by assisting with maintenance, repairs and testing of healthcare equipment such as beds, motorised scooters and wheelchairs as well as a wide variety of other medical equipment and health aids.
On a day-to-day basis you will:

  • Troubleshoot and complete repairs and servicing
  • Maintain up-to-date and concise service records
  • Maintain servicing equipment and ensure the company vehicle is kept in good condition
  • Manage some servicing and parts inventory
  • Maintain the safety and integrity of all serviced products in accordance with Australian Standards and Company policy

About You

  • You have a Mechanical or Service Technician background with a combination of education and experience
  • You’re a hands-on “fixer” and love to problem solve and find solutions
  • You’re an independent worker and can manage your own time effectively and efficiently
  • You have strong communication skills and pride yourself on your excellent customer service
  • Ideally you have a Test and Tag certification
  • A current and valid driver’s license is essential

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a reputable Australian business and make a considerable difference in the lives of people within Aged Care facilities and the Community.

job.title: Product Manager, Cardiology (Sydney)
job.description:

  • Join one of the largest providers of medical-surgical products and supply chain solutions globally
  • Hybrid working – 2 days in office, 3 from home

Portfolio: Cardiac and interventional consumables

This is a hands-on Product Manager role with responsibility for the full portfolio across ANZ.

job.title: Territory Manager - Joint Replacement - Melbourne
job.description:
Territory Sales Manager – Orthopaedics - Melbourne

 

Join a Specialist Orthopaedic Manufacturer with an Outstanding Clinical Reputation

An exciting opportunity has become available to join a highly respected orthopaedic manufacturer that has built its reputation on clinical excellence rather than portfolio size.

 

With a focused range of orthopaedic implant solutions supported by outstanding long-term clinical data, this business has earned the trust of surgeons by consistently delivering quality, innovation, and exceptional patient outcomes.

 

As the business continues to grow across Australia, they are seeking an experienced Territory Sales Manager to drive market expansion, strengthen surgeon relationships, and support the continued adoption of their specialist orthopaedic portfolio.

 

About the Role

Reporting into the Sales Director, you'll take ownership of your territory, driving commercial growth through strategic account management, business development, and outstanding clinical support.

Working closely with a Business Development Manager, you'll create a unified approach to customer engagement while providing hands-on operating theatre support and delivering exceptional service to surgeons and hospital stakeholders.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced orthopaedic sales professional who enjoys building long-term partnerships and representing products backed by outstanding clinical evidence.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Achieve and exceed territory sales and growth objectives
  • Develop new business opportunities while growing existing surgeon relationships
  • Increase utilisation of a specialist orthopaedic implant portfolio
  • Deliver high-quality in-theatre clinical support and product expertise
  • Build trusted relationships with surgeons, theatre staff, procurement teams, and hospital executives
  • Work collaboratively with Business Development, Clinical Education, Operations, and Customer Service teams
  • Maintain accurate CRM activity, forecasting, and pipeline management
  • Deliver educational presentations and product training to healthcare professionals
  • Monitor market activity and provide commercial insights to support business strategy

 

About You

You'll be an ambitious and commercially driven medical device professional who enjoys working closely with surgeons and thrives in a theatre-based environment.

You'll ideally bring:

  • Proven success in orthopaedic or medical device sales
  • Experience managing and growing a sales territory
  • Strong understanding of orthopaedic implant systems and surgical procedures
  • Excellent relationship-building, negotiation, and presentation skills
  • A proactive, organised, and accountable approach to territory management
  • Experience using CRM systems to manage pipeline and forecasting
  • Tertiary qualifications in Business, Science, Healthcare, or a related discipline

Existing relationships within the Australian orthopaedic market will be highly regarded.

 

Why Join?

  • Represent a specialist orthopaedic manufacturer renowned for exceptional clinical outcomes
  • Sell products supported by excellent long-term clinical evidence and surgeon confidence
  • Join a growing organisation where your contribution has genuine impact
  • Work within an agile business that values collaboration, innovation, and customer partnerships
  • Build lasting relationships with leading orthopaedic surgeons across your territory
  • Competitive salary package with performance incentives, vehicle allowance, and career development opportunities

 

This Opportunity Is Ideal For

  • An experienced Orthopaedic Territory Manager looking for greater ownership and autonomy.
  • A high-performing medical device sales professional wanting to represent a focused, premium portfolio rather than a broad product range.
  • Someone who values quality, clinical credibility, and building long-term surgeon partnerships over transactional selling.

 

If you're passionate about orthopaedics and want to represent products that genuinely make a difference to patient outcomes, please reach out to Jonathan Gertler 0406 423 734

job.title: Product Specialist - Joint Replacement - Perth
job.description:
Product Specialist – Joint Reconstruction

📍 Perth | Full-Time

Join a Global Leader in Orthopaedic Innovation

An exciting opportunity has become available for an ambitious and clinically focused sales professional to join a market-leading orthopaedic business within its Joint Reconstruction division.

Working across Perth's hospital network, you'll partner with leading orthopaedic surgeons, theatre teams, and healthcare professionals to support the adoption of innovative hip and knee technologies that improve patient outcomes.

This role offers the perfect blend of relationship management, clinical support, and commercial responsibility within one of the most dynamic sectors of the medical device industry.

About the Role

As a Product Specialist, you will be responsible for driving sales growth across a designated territory while providing exceptional clinical support and education to healthcare professionals.

You will build trusted relationships with surgeons and hospital stakeholders, support procedures in theatre, and help introduce new technologies that improve surgical outcomes and patient care.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced clinical environment and wants to develop their career within a high-performing orthopaedic team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Achieve and exceed territory sales targets through strategic account management
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with surgeons, theatre staff, nurses, and key hospital stakeholders
  • Provide high-quality operating theatre support and case coverage
  • Develop and execute account plans to drive product adoption and market share growth
  • Deliver product education, in-service training, and clinical workshops
  • Support the launch and adoption of new technologies and product innovations
  • Monitor market activity, competitor trends, and customer opportunities
  • Collaborate closely with sales, marketing, and commercial teams to drive business objectives

About You

To be successful in this role, you will ideally have:

  • Experience in medical device sales, orthopaedics, or a related healthcare environment
  • Previous exposure to operating theatres or surgical settings highly regarded
  • Strong relationship-building and stakeholder engagement skills
  • Excellent communication and presentation abilities
  • A proactive, commercially minded approach with a passion for delivering results
  • The ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Tertiary qualifications in Business, Health Sciences, Nursing, Physiotherapy, Biomedical Science, or a related discipline (preferred)

Why Join?

  • Represent a highly respected global orthopaedic portfolio
  • Work alongside leading surgeons and healthcare professionals
  • Be part of a collaborative and high-performing team culture
  • Access ongoing professional development and career progression opportunities
  • Competitive salary package, performance incentives, and vehicle allowance
  • Opportunity to make a genuine impact on patient outcomes through innovative technology

Location

Based in Perth, with regular travel across your designated territory and attendance in hospital operating theatres.

If you're passionate about healthcare, technology, and building strong clinical partnerships, I'd love to hear from you. jonathan.gertler@one.com.au / 0406423734
